rv.q: With little to surprise us beyond the odd jarring sound effect, the play drifts towards Victorian melodrama: too much expository dialogue, too little tension and an ending that is uncharacteristically predictable.

The Psychic never quite reaches those heights, but its strong performances, polished stagecraft and enjoyably old-fashioned sense of theatrical misdirection still make for an engaging evening of entertainment.
For fans of intelligent thrillers, strong performances, and beautifully crafted atmosphere, it is absolutely worth seeing.
That said, The Psychic is a cut above most productions and absolutely worth checking out on its long run in York, marking it out as still one of the must-see shows of the year.
